title: SecureMon
description:
In the dynamic and intricate world of blockchains, the security of smart contracts across various EVM-compatible chains is a paramount concern. 

SecureMon steps in as a comprehensive solution, designed to bolster security across this diverse landscape. It serves as an essential tool in monitoring smart contracts, applicable to a wide range of EVM chains, known for their flexibility and widespread adoption in the blockchain community.

SecureMon's core strength lies in its advanced monitoring capabilities. The platform is engineered to continuously scrutinize smart contracts across EVM chains for unusual activities, thereby identifying potential security threats before they escalate. This approach is vital in the blockchain realm where security oversights can lead to substantial financial losses and undermine trust in the technology.

how_its_made:
The primary challenge was integrating real-time data feeds effectively to monitor and predict security threats. Overcoming this involved developing efficient algorithms and leveraging third-party tools like Forta, Powerlool. We also had to reverse-engineer a few things. 

Another hurdle was ensuring minimal false positives while maintaining high sensitivity to actual threats.
